excluded_tools.get_presigned_url: Issues pre-signed Amazon S3 URLs for upload and download. A pre-signed upload URL is a write capability, so it is outside this read-only boundary.

notes: Read-only is enforced by IAM on the gateway role, not by the tool set: run_script inherits the role's permissions and cannot exceed them.
run_script is the AWS API execution tool in the current server tool list; there is no separate call_aws tool.
The Cedar policies in aws-mcp-boundary.tf are generated from this manifest, so adding a tool here also requires a matching policy decision.
